en.item_spear_gold_frostfire_description: Dipped in frozen flames, this spear spells certain doom.
en.item_spear_gold_frostfire_uncooked_descr: The same mould, yet inclined to yield a more spectacular result... The frost shall reveal all, in time.
en.item_spear_gold_uncooked_description: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.
en.item_spear_splitner_blood_description: A small sacrifice must be made for every battle...
en.item_spear_splitner_description: Split your enemies' hearts in two.
en.item_spear_splitner_lightning_descriptio: Let the crack of thunder split the air.
en.item_spear_splitner_nature_description: Nature's forces burst through the ground wherever this spear strikes.
en.item_spear_wolffang_description: Even in death, the wolf's tooth aches for flesh.
en.item_spear_wood_description: This is just as sharp as a real spear, if a real spear was made out of wood.
en.item_spiceashlands_description: Whatever spices have been used in this blend, they must come from someplace hot. And as if that wasn't enough, they have also been dried and smoked before being ground into a fine powder.
en.item_spicedeepnorth_description: Using cinnamon bark and ginger root, with a touch of nutmeg, the herbalist has travelled far to create this fine and warming blend of spices.
en.item_spiceforests_description: Thyme and marjoram carefully harvested and dried, before being mixed together. This blend will turn even the most basic of ingredients into a delicious feast.
en.item_spicemistlands_description: A good herbalist knows exactly where to go to find ramsons, but she won't tell you the secrets of her trade! Still, if you have the coin for it you may treat yourself to this blend of finely harvested ramson bulbs and leaves.
en.item_spicemountains_description: Only the most seasoned herbalist can find the pepperwood tree and harvest its leaves and bark. After careful preparation it's ready to be added to food, and is sure to give it some warming heat.
en.item_spiceoceans_description: The sour tang of sorrel, mixed with something the herbalist would rather not disclose, is well suitable for fish. Any fisherfolk worth their salt would do well to keep this blend near, in case of a good catch!
en.item_spiceplains_description: This blend utilises all aspects of the lovage plant, a rarity in the tenth world. Roots, leaves and seeds have all been gathered, and then mixed together in the perfect quantity.
en.item_spicymarmalade_description: Sugary honey perfectly balanced with tangy fronds and tart berries.
en.item_staff_frostorbs_description: A caged snowflake, endless patterns emerging from within...
en.item_staff_lightning_description: What happens next may shock you.
en.item_staff_orbofahri_description: A chill that goes right through to the bone.
en.item_staff_orbofahri_uncooked_descriptio: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.
en.item_staff_spiritcaller_description: Summon otherworldly aid. It only costs a drop of your blood...
en.item_staff_spiritcaller_uncooked_descrip: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.
en.item_staff_thunderblood_description: Simply point, and you shall summon the wrath of the sky.
en.item_staff_thunderblood_uncooked_descrip: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.
en.item_staffclusterbomb_description: Only those with patience and focus will be able to harness the true power of this staff.
en.item_stafffireball_description: The sweltering heat of Muspelheim seems almost pathetic when compared to what this staff can do...
en.item_staffgreenroots_description: Ancient natural forces lie curled and dormant within this staff, ready to be unleashed.
en.item_stafficeshards_description: A staff as cold as the three-year winter that will herald the end of times.
en.item_staffredlightning_description: What happens next may shock you.
en.item_staffredtroll_description: Summons a raging beast to cause death and destruction.
en.item_staffshield_description: For a slight blood offering it will protect the caster in a magical shell.
en.item_staffskeleton_description: Sacrifice a bit of blood to raise the dead. Upgrade the skull to spawn multiple skeletons, and increase your blood magic to make them stronger.
en.item_stagbreaker_description: A weapon worthy of the Gods! If you get hit with this, you'll know it...
en.item_sword_blackmetal_description: A thing of death and beauty. It catches the light with a greenish glow.
en.item_sword_dyrnwyn_description: The sword that was broken is whole once more. Its flames burn hot, fuelled by the memories of ancient warriors.
en.item_sword_fire_description: Unsheathed, it sizzles and spits with deathless fire, an impossible blade.
en.item_sword_gold_bloodlightning_descripti: As the blood runs along the blade, it awakens the storm within.
en.item_sword_gold_bloodlightning_uncooked_: The same mould, yet inclined to yield a more spectacular result... The frost shall reveal all, in time.
en.item_sword_gold_description: Even in the faintest sunlight, this weapon glimmers.
en.item_sword_gold_frostfire_description: Flames dance along this blade, but are they hot or cold?
en.item_sword_gold_frostfire_uncooked_descr: The same mould, yet inclined to yield a more spectacular result... The frost shall reveal all, in time.
en.item_sword_gold_uncooked_description: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.
en.item_sword_iron_description: The straight line between life and death runs along the edge of this blade.
en.item_sword_krom_description: As deadly as it is shiny, and it's very shiny.
en.item_sword_mistwalker_description: The faint glow seems to slice through the mist.
en.item_sword_niedhogg_blood_description: If you bleed, your foes are sure to do so as well.
en.item_sword_niedhogg_description: Named after the evil dragon that dwells by the roots of the world tree, this sword heralds doom for those who cross its path.
en.item_sword_niedhogg_lightning_descriptio: The power of lightning dances along the blade of this sword, a promise of the pain to come.
en.item_sword_niedhogg_nature_description: Tangle your foes in roots, like the namesake of this blade.
en.item_sword_silver_description: Purest of metals, nothing unclean can abide its touch.
en.item_sword_slayer_blood_description: If it bleeds, you can kill it.
en.item_sword_slayer_description: This mighty blade thirsts for the blood of foes.
en.item_sword_slayer_lightning_description: The lightning bound into this blade is erratic, ever searching for something to strike.
en.item_sword_slayer_nature_description: The blade works in tandem with the primal forces of the world, seeking death and slaughter.
en.item_sword_sword_2h_description: Would you be careful with that, please?
en.item_sword_wood_description: Mostly harmless, unless you're very persistent.
en.item_sword2h_gold_bloodlightning_descrip: Anyone wielding this weapon is sure to be very frightening indeed.
en.item_sword2h_gold_bloodlightning_uncooke: The same mould, yet inclined to yield a more spectacular result... The frost shall reveal all, in time.
en.item_sword2h_gold_description: A striking weapon, both visually and lethally.
en.item_sword2h_gold_frostfire_description: The choice between a fiery end and a frozen one is simple: Both at the same time.
en.item_sword2h_gold_frostfire_uncooked_des: The same mould, yet inclined to yield a more spectacular result... The frost shall reveal all, in time.
en.item_sword2h_gold_uncooked_description: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.
en.item_tankard_anniversary_description: One year since we arrived... Skål!
en.item_tankard_odin_description: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest drinks.
en.item_tin_description: A bar of pure tin ready to be worked.
en.item_tinore_description: Unrefined tin. Needs to be refined in a smelter.
en.item_torch_description: It brings light and warmth, drives back the darkness.
en.item_trinketblackdamagedealth_descriptio: Your mind hardens, as do your blows.
en.item_trinketblackdtamina_description: Dance with death as you dodge your enemies' strikes.
en.item_trinketbloodgoldhealth_description: Claw and bone and gold – grant them blood and they shall grant you a boon.
en.item_trinketbloodgoldstamina_description: They say that the soul of a witch can grant strange powers to mortals...
en.item_trinketbronzehealth_description: It pulsates with fragments of ancient life.
en.item_trinketbronzestamina_description: A beautiful pendant, harbouring the endurance of a bear.
en.item_trinketcarapaceeitr_description: If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint echoes of lost souls...
en.item_trinketchitinswim_description: Empty your mind as you become shapeless and one with the water.
en.item_trinketflametalstaminahealth_descri: It's warm, as if filled with a lifesblood of its own.
en.item_trinketironstamina_description: Puts a spring in your step!
en.item_trinketscalestaminadamage_descripti: A razor-sharp ankle chain. Can it truly be comfortable?
en.item_trinketsilverdamage_description: Assume the sharp and furious mind of a wolf.
en.item_trinketsilverresist_description: A shard of frozen sorrow. Touching it makes you feel almost numb.
en.item_trollhide_description: A thick and sturdy hide. This is why trolls are so hard to kill.
en.item_trophy_abomination_description: A tangled mess of roots and bark.
en.item_trophy_abomination_lore: It's been dead so long that it started living again.
en.item_trophy_asksvin_description: Don't let yourself be fooled by the friendly smile, for it could easily bite your arm off.
en.item_trophy_asksvin_lore: A mighty beast, but now it shall roam no more.
en.item_trophy_barka_description: The frozen head of a once-living tree.
en.item_trophy_barka_lore: A forest creature, metamorphosed into living frost.
en.item_trophy_bjorn_lore: Mistakenly, it believed itself the master of the forest.
en.item_trophy_bjorn_undead_description: These eyes are finally vacant for good.
en.item_trophy_bjorn_undead_lore: The most dreaded shadow of the night.
en.item_trophy_blob_description: A smelly lump of sticky matter.
en.item_trophy_blob_frost_description: It's like a shard of ice, only...slimy?
en.item_trophy_blob_frost_lore: No matter the passage of time, it remains frozen.
en.item_trophy_blob_lava_lore: Even now, it's burning hot to the touch.
en.item_trophy_blob_morkhalla_description: Remains of unfortunate adventurers, digested and jellified over time.
en.item_trophy_blob_morkhalla_lore: It still jiggles, but you're fairly certain that it's dead.
en.item_trophy_boar_description: This boar head would make for a nice decoration in any house.
en.item_trophy_boar_lore: Any viking worth their axe should know how to slay a boar.
en.item_trophy_bonemass_description: Bones and viscous goo, held together by some unseen force.  Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
en.item_trophy_bonemass_lore: A mess of black soil and old bone, thankfully quiet now.
en.item_trophy_bonemaw_description: A skull made up of dense bone, as dangerous as it is protective.
en.item_trophy_bonemaw_lore: These jagged teeth had been the death of many a seafarer, before the beast finally met its own end.
en.item_trophy_brutebro_lore: The younger of two brothers. Jealous of his brother's magic.
en.item_trophy_charredarcher_description: These legs could hold infinite power.
en.item_trophy_charredmage_description: A warm glow seems to almost emanate from within. Handle with care.
en.item_trophy_charredmage_lore: If you listen closely, you can still hear the faint hum of magic.
en.item_trophy_charredmelee_description: Fractures line this skull, as if it has taken many hits over the years.
en.item_trophy_charredmelee_lore: Even in death, its gaze is unrelenting.
en.item_trophy_cultist_description: My, what big teeth it has...
en.item_trophy_cultist_hildir_description: He's giving you an icy stare.
en.item_trophy_cultist_hildir_lore: Isolated from his kin for embracing the white frost instead of resisting it.
en.item_trophy_cultist_lore: The fire in its eyes has still not burned out.
en.item_trophy_deathsquito_description: You don't like touching this thing even when it's dead.
en.item_trophy_deathsquito_lore: It's strange that we should suffer so much over so small a thing.
en.item_trophy_deer_description: A fine specimen, but you'll need to kill more than deer to enter Valhalla.
en.item_trophy_deer_lore: Seemingly identical to the ones found in Midgard.
en.item_trophy_dragonqueen_description: The head of a dragon, majestic even in the rigor of death.  Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
en.item_trophy_dragonqueen_lore: Scored with ancient scars, this head was the last sight of countless warriors.
en.item_trophy_draugr_description: Bind up the mouth if it starts to whisper in the night...
en.item_trophy_draugr_lore: What should have been left to rest in peace has been awoken, twisted and corrupted.
en.item_trophy_draugrelite_description: The dead stare of the glowing red eyes sends a shiver through your bones.
en.item_trophy_draugrelite_lore: Perhaps this was once a mighty warrior, worthy of praise. Now it is but a rotten, horrid corpse.
en.item_trophy_dvergr_description: It's frankly a little troubling that you would consider hanging these on your wall...
en.item_trophy_eikthyr_description: This severed head oozes power.  Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
en.item_trophy_eikthyr_lore: Once the king of the forest, the size of the antlers is truly impressive.
en.item_trophy_elaking_description: Mean little eyes stare back at you.
en.item_trophy_elaking_lore: Was it driven by cruelty or mischief? We may never know.
en.item_trophy_elder_description: This severed head oozes power.  Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
en.item_trophy_elder_lore: Even in death, it seems to grin with secret knowledge.
en.item_trophy_fader_description: The green dragon, corrupted beyond redemption.  Offer him to the sacrificial stones.
en.item_trophy_fader_lore: Only tatters remained of his sane mind. Perhaps it was a mercy to kill him.
en.item_trophy_fallenvalkyrie_description: Though she is dead, she yearns for the blood to flow.
en.item_trophy_fallenvalkyrie_lore: Once a fierce and noble being, before she was warped into a harbinger of terror.
en.item_trophy_fenring_description: A strange, elongated paw, its claws razor sharp.
en.item_trophy_fenring_lore: Halfway between wolf and man, forever frozen in a snarl of pain.
en.item_trophy_foresttroll_description: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.
en.item_trophy_foresttroll_lore: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.
en.item_trophy_frosttroll_description: The eyes still glitter and swirl with silvery flecks. Don't look into them for too long...
en.item_trophy_frosttroll_lore: The eyes still glitter and swirl with silvery flecks. Don't look into them for too long...
en.item_trophy_ghost_description: Does it still whisper about unfinished business?
en.item_trophy_ghost_lore: There is still something haunting about its presence...
en.item_trophy_gjall_lore: A most peculiar creature, shaped by a most peculiar place.
en.item_trophy_goblin_description: Loose folds of greenish skin gathered in around a pair of dark and hateful eyes.
en.item_trophy_goblin_lore: Sometimes, you swear you can still hear its echoing laughter.
en.item_trophy_goblinbrute_description: The huge grizzled head is as heavy as a boulder.
en.item_trophy_goblinbrute_lore: Praised for its strength, it lived only to defend its village.
en.item_trophy_goblinking_description: The crownless head of a dead king.  Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
en.item_trophy_goblinking_lore: Sometimes, the eyes still move and the lips mutter silently...
en.item_trophy_goblinshaman_description: It shall cast no more spells against you.
en.item_trophy_goblinshaman_lore: Even killing it couldn't wipe the knowing smile from its crooked lips...
en.item_trophy_greydwarf_description: The mossy, severed head of a Greydwarf.
en.item_trophy_greydwarf_lore: Woe be upon those who disturb their forests...
en.item_trophy_greydwarfbrute_description: It took seven blows to hack this gnarled head from its body.
en.item_trophy_greydwarfbrute_lore: Roots and stones, twisted by dark intents.
en.item_trophy_greydwarfshaman_description: It may try to come back so be sure to prune any new shoots...
en.item_trophy_greydwarfshaman_lore: Primal magic once coursed through it. Perhaps some still lingers...
en.item_trophy_growth_lore: Whatever brought this creature to life is now long gone.
en.item_trophy_hare_description: These are said to bring luck. But not for their original owner.
en.item_trophy_hare_lore: A rather odd animal, of both scale and fur.
en.item_trophy_hatchling_lore: A young dragon – hopefully its mother will not seek vengeance.
en.item_trophy_jotunwarrior_description: Once a mighty warrior, now nought but a husk remains.
en.item_trophy_jotunwarrior_lore: A hardened soldier. What battles has he witnessed?
en.item_trophy_jotunwitch_description: Before her death, her eyes sparked with magic. Now they're empty and void.
en.item_trophy_jotunwitch_lore: A powerful witch. What strange mysteries was she privy to?
en.item_trophy_leech_description: Although slimy, the skin is beautifully patterned in red and black.
en.item_trophy_leech_lore: A whole life spent in a dark swamp, now come to an untimely end.
en.item_trophy_lox_description: A giant beast's head, thatched with thick fur.
en.item_trophy_lox_lore: A beast capable of both loyalty and destruction.
en.item_trophy_mole_description: Getting slashed by these claws would be very unpleasant.
en.item_trophy_mole_lore: This eyeless one shall dig no more.
en.item_trophy_moose_description: The mighty ruler of the northern forests.
en.item_trophy_moose_lore: A majestic beast, and an iconic piece of decor.
en.item_trophy_morgen_description: The waking nightmare has met its end.
en.item_trophy_morgen_lore: Only the most twisted of minds could summon such a creature.
en.item_trophy_neck_description: The beady eyes and razor sharp teeth belie the ostensibly calm nature of this small lizard.
en.item_trophy_neck_lore: These creatures thrive in water, until a viking lands on their shores.
en.item_trophy_seal_description: This animal never did any harm, yet it met an untimely end.
en.item_trophy_seal_lore: Those big, sad eyes stare back at you. What have you done?
en.item_trophy_seeker_brute_description: The head of a fallen champion.
en.item_trophy_seeker_brute_lore: The strongest of the brood, raised to be a mighty warrior.
en.item_trophy_seeker_description: Less delicate than they look. The leather of the wings catches the firelight as if remembering flight.
en.item_trophy_seeker_lore: Relying on sound rather than sight, this creature was a most dangerous foe in the fog.
en.item_trophy_seekerqueen_description: She has seen enough.  Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
en.item_trophy_serpent_description: The scales have dulled but the eyes are still bright.
en.item_trophy_serpent_lore: It ruled the seas unchallenged – until now.
en.item_trophy_sgolem_description: This crystalline rock formation would make for an impressive floor decoration.
en.item_trophy_sgolem_lore: Rock and crystal, brought to life by ancient magic.
en.item_trophy_shamanbro_description: In the choice of 'ride or die', he picked the latter.
en.item_trophy_shamanbro_lore: The elder brother. Wished he had his brother's strength.
en.item_trophy_skeleton_description: The expressionless grin of this skull reminds you of the inevitability of death.
en.item_trophy_skeleton_hildir_lore: Her rage burned so hot it stayed with her after death.
en.item_trophy_skeleton_lore: It died and then rose again. Is this the fate that awaits you?
en.item_trophy_skeletonpoison_description: A rank and rotten skull. You're not sure why you kept it...
en.item_trophy_skeletonpoison_lore: To end its lingering existence was most likely a mercy.
en.item_trophy_surtling_description: Wreathed in pale flame, it still smoulders like an ember.
en.item_trophy_surtling_lore: A fiendish creature, born of fire.
en.item_trophy_tick_lore: Perhaps one of the most nasty things you have encountered. Fortunately, it's dead!
en.item_trophy_troll_description: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.
en.item_trophy_troll_lore: Though this world is its domain, you have proven it can be defeated.
en.item_trophy_ulv_description: A rugged tail from a not so good boy.
en.item_trophy_ulv_lore: Despite its bestial nature, there was something intelligent about it.
en.item_trophy_volture_description: It's like a vulture, but it thrives in volcanic climates.
en.item_trophy_volture_lore: Its watchful eyes still seem to search for cadavers to feast upon.
en.item_trophy_wolf_description: Frozen in death, the hair matted with blood and a silent howl lodged in its throat.
en.item_trophy_wolf_lore: This animal has the potential to be a viking's greatest friend – or their greatest enemy.
en.item_trophy_wraith_description: The shed skin of a wraith, a flowing robe only visible by moonlight.
en.item_trophy_wraith_lore: At last, this restless spirit has been set free.
en.item_trophy_writhan_description: Tough dead, it should probably be handled delicately.
en.item_trophy_writhan_lore: It remains dormant, at least for now...
en.item_turnip_description: A dense vegetable, rich with nutrition.
en.item_turnipseeds_description: Plant to grow a healthy turnip.
en.item_turretbolt_bloodgold_description: Your attacker shall stand no chance as this missile finds its target.
en.item_turretbolt_description: These thick missiles can punch through the hide of even the toughest foes.
en.item_turretbolt_flametal_description: Forged from one of the hardest metals in all of Valheim, this missile is sure to hold off your enemies.
en.item_turretboltwood_description: Sturdy wooden missiles that can provide a tough defense against foes.
en.item_UndeadBjornRibcage_description: A relic of savage strength, perfect for forging armour that bears the wild’s fury.
en.item_upgrader_description: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice.
en.item_vikingcupcake_description: A sweet and tasty treat, to celebrate a feat!
en.item_vineberry_description: These juicy berries are both sour and sweet.
en.item_vineberryseeds_description: Looks like they could crumble at any moment.
en.item_vinegreenseeds_description: These unassuming seeds can grow into vines that might overtake entire buildings.
en.item_volture_meat_cooked_description: A chewy and somewhat dry meat. Some seasoning would probably make it taste better, but it'll fill your stomach regardless.
en.item_volture_meat_description: Given that this bird feasts on all kinds of things, you'd better cook its meat before you even think about eating it.
en.item_voltureegg_description: Warm to the touch, and full of protein.
en.item_wishbone_description: This ancient bone remembers the location of many forgotten things.
en.item_witheredbone_description: A giant bone, knotted like old wood.
en.item_wolfclaw_description: It is hard and sharp like iron.
en.item_wolfhairbundle_description: A bundle of thick, rough hair. It has a strong smell.
en.item_wood_description: Good, strong wood to build with.
en.item_writhanroots_description: The gnarled body parts of a strange, offputting creature.
en.item_yagluththing_description: The remains of Yagluth, a twisted spirit torn between this world and the next.
en.item_yggdrasilporridge_description: Made with sap from the great tree. Even a mouthful imparts a warm glow to your whole body.
en.item_yggdrasilwood_description: Godflesh, wood from the Great Tree.
en.item_ymirremains_description: The earthy remains of the giant Ymir.
en.piece_ancientmetalbarstack_description: It's unclear what this could be used for...
en.piece_armorstand_description: Some clothes are just too nice to fold away. Why not put them on display instead?
en.piece_artisan_ext1_description: This intricate tool is needed for crafting more advanced designs.
en.piece_artisanstation_description: To build machinery and craft complicated designs, an artisan table is required.
en.piece_ashwood_bed_description: Rest easy on this finely crafted bed, with asksvin hides to insulate you from heat and cold alike.
en.piece_ashwood_decowall_description: You could watch this pattern for hours...
en.piece_ashwood_decowall_divider_descripti: Adds a nice detail to any room.
en.piece_ashwood_decowall_tree_description: Are you looking out the window or at the window? Nobody needs to know.
en.piece_ashwood_door_description: The detailed decorations might make you stop and look instead of actually going through.
en.piece_ashwood_floor_deco_description: Patterns work great on the floor as well.
en.piece_ashwood_poles_description: These supports are always warm to the touch.
en.piece_ashwoodstair_description: These stairs are sturdier than they might appear.
en.piece_ashwoodwall_description: Both sides of this wall have their own charm. The choice is yours!
en.piece_asksvinskeleton_description: Gruesome or decorative? That is up to you.
en.piece_banner01_description: A black banner, like the depths of Hel.
en.piece_banner02_description: A blue banner, like the oceans around Midgard.
en.piece_banner03_description: A red striped banner, like a sail for a ship.
en.piece_banner04_description: A red banner, like the blood of Odin's foes.
en.piece_banner05_description: A green banner, like the lush forests of Alfheim.
en.piece_banner06_description: A red and blue striped banner, because sometimes you can't pick a colour.
en.piece_banner07_description: A blue striped banner, like a sail for a ship.
en.piece_banner08_description: A yellow banner, like the golden fields of Vanaheim.
en.piece_banner09_description: A purple banner, like strange magics.
en.piece_banner10_description: An orange banner, like the fires of Muspelheim.
en.piece_banner11_description: A white banner, like the snow in Niflheim.
en.piece_barber_description: Helps you stay up to date with the latest viking fashion.
en.piece_bathtub_description: Respectable vikings bathe as often as once per week!
en.piece_bed_description: When night falls, you'll want somewhere to sleep.
en.piece_bed02_description: Draped in furs, this bed is sure to give you a good night's sleep.
en.piece_beehive_area: The bees don't like this biome
en.piece_beehive_description: When they're happy, the bees will produce tasty honey.
en.piece_beehive_freespace: The bees need more open space
en.piece_bench_runed_description: A rustic yet comfortable place to sit.
en.piece_bench01_description: If there is room in your heart, there is room for your butt.
en.piece_benchlog_description: It's nothing fancy, but it's better than sitting on the ground.
en.piece_birdnest_area: The birds don't like it here
en.piece_birdnest_description: Healthy and happy birds might shed a feather or two.

es.item_axehead2_description: ¿Qué batallas habrá presenciado esta arma? No puedes ver su pasado, solo darle forma a su futuro.
es.item_bakedpoteitr_description: Ni hervido, ni triturado, ni en guiso. ¡Pero igualmente delicioso!
es.item_bakedpoteitr_uncooked_description: Listo para meter en el horno.
es.item_barkabranch_description: Este trozo de madera estuvo una vez animado y vivo. Aún conserva un extraño aire mágico.
es.item_barleywine: Vino de cebada resistente al fuego
es.item_barleywinebase: Base de vino de cebada: Resistencia al fuego
es.item_barrelrings_description: Estos anillos de metal son perfectamente redondos y sirven para mantener unido un barril. ¡Solo tienes que añadir madera!
es.item_battleaxe_blackmetal: Hacha de batalla de metal negro
es.item_battleaxe_blackmetal_description: El verde será lo último que vean tus enemigos antes de que los partas en dos.
es.item_battleaxe_crystal_description: Se ve a través de los tajos.
es.item_battleaxe_description: Rompecráneos. La alegría de todo guerrero.
es.item_battleaxe_gold_uncooked_description: Hay que endurecer esta arma con escarcha.
es.item_battleaxe_skullsplittur_description: Encontrarás cráneos que partir incluso en las brumas más densas.
es.item_battleaxe_wood_description: Intimida, pero no tanto como la versión real.
es.item_beechseeds_description: Plántalas para que crezca un haya.
es.item_bellfragment_description: Este antiguo fragmento parece ser un trozo de campana rota...
es.item_beltstrength_description: Le concede a quien lo lleve una fuerza sobrehumana.
es.item_bilebag_description: Bilis caústico recogido del cadáver de un gjall.
es.item_birchseeds_description: Plántalas para que crezca un abedul.
es.item_bjorn_meat_description: Esta carne llena de grasa se suponía que iba a ser para mantener el cuerpo durante la hibernación.
es.item_bjornhide_description: Una gruesa y peluda piel, áspera pero increíblemente suave.
es.item_bjornpaw_description: Estas afiladas garras son perfectas para recolectar cerezos - o desmembrar presas.
es.item_blackcore_description: Llenado hasta el límite con un poder antiguo.
es.item_blackmarble_description: Un bloque de piedra sólida, cosida en colores cambiantes.
es.item_blackmetal_description: Un lingote pesado de metal oscuro.
es.item_blacksoup_description: Un equilibrio perfecto entre dulce y ácido.
es.item_blackwood_description: Madera endurecida por fuego y ceniza.
es.item_blobvial_description: Suficientemente resistente como para contener algo volátil, pero lo suficientemente frágil como para romperse.
es.item_bloodclot_description: Ten cuidado de no perforar esto mientras lo cargas...
es.item_bloodgoldkey_description: Si hay una llave, entonces debe de haber una cerradura.
es.item_blubber_cooked_description: Una carne correosa, con un regusto a remordimiento.
es.item_blubber_description: La grasa aislante de una criatura adaptada a las aguas del norte.
es.item_bolt_blackmetal_description: Un pulcro virote de metal negro.
es.item_bolt_bloodgold_description: Un virote forjado con los que posiblemente sean los materiales más duros de este mundo...
es.item_bolt_bone_description: Un tosco virote de hueso amarillento.
es.item_bolt_charred_description: El hueso resistente de un antebrazo, con forma de flecha mortal.
es.item_bomb_dynamite_description: Brasas atrapadas, listas para estallar. Se recomienda precaución.
es.item_bombblob_frost_description: Si lo sostienes por mucho tiempo tu mano podría congelarse.
es.item_bombblob_lava_description: El frasco se siente caliente en tu mano, y te promete destrucción ardiente.
es.item_bombblob_morkhalla_description: En la mazmorra es donde está el pegote.
es.item_bombblob_poison_description: En caso de que se rompa, se aconseja mucha precaución.
es.item_bombblob_poisonelite_description: No se recomienda inhalar el humo.
es.item_bombblob_tar_description: Puedes sentir los latidos de la sustancia pegajosa que se encuentra dentro, como si te amenazara.
es.item_bonemawmeat_cooked_description: El mar hirviendo no le hizo nada a esta carne, pero asarla al fuego le ha dado un delicioso toque crujiente.
es.item_bonemawmeat_description: Una carne de pescado blanca y sabrosa. ¡Muy buena para los huesos!
es.item_bonemawscale_description: Parece hueso. Mejor no cuestionar demasiado la anatomía de esta criatura...
es.item_bonemawtooth_description: Esto ha causado la muerte de muchos marineros valientes.
es.item_bow_ashlands_description: Resucitado de las cenizas, este arco posee una fuerza inquebrantable.
es.item_bow_ashlandsblood_description: Las flechas lanzadas con este arco desgarrarán la carne con una ferocidad inigualable.
es.item_bow_ashlandsroot_description: Así como la rama retorcida busca el sol, este arco busca la matanza.
es.item_bow_ashlandsstorm_description: Deja que tus flechas sean tan ágiles como un rayo que cae.
es.item_bow_draugrfang_description: Madera oscura acordonada con tendones brillantes. Es algo atroz.
es.item_bow_finewood_description: Un arco simple hecho de madera fuerte y flexible.
es.item_bow_gold_bloodlightning_description: El relámpago danza en la cuerda, esperando ser liberado.
es.item_bow_gold_bloodlightning_uncooked: Pieza fundida: arco de sangre de trueno
es.item_bow_gold_bloodlightning_uncooked_de: El mismo molde, pero con tendencia a dar un resultado más espectacular... La escarcha lo revelará todo, con el tiempo.
es.item_bow_gold_description: Este arco dará en el blanco con una precisión milimétrica.
es.item_bow_gold_frostfire_description: Mantén la cabeza fría al tensar, y luego desata tu furia con las flechas.
es.item_bow_gold_frostfire_uncooked: Pieza fundida: arco de fuego gélido
es.item_bow_gold_frostfire_uncooked_descrip: El mismo molde, pero con tendencia a dar un resultado más espectacular... La escarcha lo revelará todo, con el tiempo.
es.item_bow_gold_uncooked_description: Hay que endurecer esta arma con escarcha.
es.item_bow_huntsman_description: Tiene una mano de obra muy fina y es la alegría de todo cazador.
es.item_bow_snipesnap_description: Usar este arco es un trabajo que te rompe la espalda, pero sí que lo vale.
es.item_bronze_description: Una aleación fuerte de cobre y estaño.
es.item_bronzenails_description: Sirven para construir barcos y muebles.
es.item_bronzescrap_description: Es viejo y oxidado, pero se puede derretir y utilizar de nuevo.
es.item_bug_meat_cooked_description: Suculenta carne blanca, un verdadero manjar.
es.item_bug_meat_description: Cuando rompes y abres sus caparazones, la carne del interior es tierna y suculenta.
es.item_candlewick_description: Sumérgelas en algo inflamable para obtener una fuente de luz duradera y acogedora.
es.item_cape_ash_description: En esta capa hay finos hilos de metal entretejidos que crear un patrón intrincado, como un destino tejido por las propias nornas.
es.item_cape_asksvin_description: Esta gruesa capa atrapa el viento, de manera similar a la vela de un barco.
es.item_cape_deepnorth_description: Una capa cálida con delicados detalles de oro hilado.
es.item_cape_deepnorth_mage_description: Hay una extraña magia tejida en esta capa, que la hace ligera y cálida.
es.item_cape_feather_description: Poniéndote esta capa te hace sentir ligero, ¡Casi como si pudieras volar!
es.item_cape_lox_description: Piel de una de las grandes bestias. Es gruesa y cálida.
es.item_cape_odin_description: Los mejores guerreros de Odín se merecen la mejor tela.
es.item_cape_trollhide_description: La piel de trol es resistente y flexible.
es.item_cape_wolf_description: Los lobos son supervivientes por naturaleza, pero este tuvo mala suerte. Su piel te dará calorcito en la nieve.
es.item_carrotseeds_description: Plántalas si te gustan las zanahorias…
es.item_carrotsoup_description: Una sopa calentita y sabrosa hecha de zanahorias.
es.item_catapult_ammo_description: Funciona mejor con una catapulta. Se aconseja precaución.
es.item_catapult_bloodgold_ammo_description: Golpéalos fuerte y cúbrelos de sangre.
es.item_catapult_training_ammo_description: Lo mejor es usarlas en una catapulta. Asegúrate de no apuntar a algo frágil.
es.item_celestialfeather_description: El único vestigio de la antigua valquiria caída.
es.item_ceramicplate_description: Por mucho que se caliente, el otro lado permanece extrañamente frío.
es.item_chain_description: Eslabón de una cadena de hierro.
es.item_charcoalresin_description: La resina de un árbol que fue incendiado hace mucho tiempo. Todavía está lista para arder un poco más.
es.item_charredbone_description: Seguido por el distintivo olor a carne quemada.
es.item_charredcogwheel_description: Esto podría usarse en alguna maquina inteligente...
es.item_charredskull_description: La calavera ennegrecida de un guerrero muerto hace mucho. Es poco probable que un entierro le traiga la paz.
es.item_chest_berserker_description: Si estos intricados diseños pueden proteger a guerreros de tierras distantes, seguramente pueden protegerte también.
es.item_chest_berserker_undead_description: Elaborado a partir de los huesos destrozados de un oso atormentado.
es.item_chest_carapace_description: Una coraza elaborada en base al bruñido caparazón de un insecto gigante.
es.item_chest_dress1_description: Un vestido sencillo de color marrón.
es.item_chest_dress2_description: Vestido marrón complementado con un cálido manto.
es.item_chest_dress3_description: Vestido marrón complementado con abalorios y plata.
es.item_chest_dress4_description: Un vestido sencillo de color azul.
es.item_chest_dress5_description: Vestido azul complementado con un cálido manto.
es.item_chest_dress6_description: Vestido azul complementado con abalorios y bronce.
es.item_chest_dress7_description: Un vestido sencillo de color amarillo.
es.item_chest_dress8_description: Vestido amarillo complementado con un cálido manto.
es.item_chest_dress9_description: Vestido amarillo complementado con abalorios y plata.
es.item_chest_fenris_description: La bestia era capaz de tomar aire en gran cantidad para que sus aullidos resonasen a millas de distancia.
es.item_chest_flametal_description: Esta fusión de misterioso llametal y huesos carbonizados sirve como una capa protectora más resistente que cualquier cosa que puedas encontrar en Midgard.
es.item_chest_gold_uncooked_description: Esta armadura necesita endurecerse con escarcha.
es.item_chest_harvester1_description: Cuando se trabaja en el campo, es importante vestirse adecuadamente. Una túnica más corta deja entrar una brisa fresca.
es.item_chest_harvester2_description: Cuando se trabaja en el campo, es importante vestirse adecuadamente. Este vestido largo mantiene las rodillas cubiertas mientras trabajas.
es.item_chest_heavy_deepnorth_description: Piel, cuero y metal trabajan juntos para desviar los golpes del enemigo.
es.item_chest_heavy_gold_uncooked_descripti: Esta armadura necesita endurecerse con escarcha.
es.item_chest_hildir_description: Propiedad de Hildir. En caso de pérdida, se ruega su devolución.
es.item_chest_iron_description: Una armadura de escamas de hierro que puede desviarlo todo, excepto los golpes demasiado fuertes.
es.item_chest_leather_description: Una túnica hecha con pieles animales.
es.item_chest_lox_description: Todavía conserva un intenso olor almizclado.
es.item_chest_mage_ashlands_description: Imbuida del poder de la primera hechicera, esta túnica otorgará una bendición a cualquiera que busque dominar el antiguo arte de la magia.
es.item_chest_mage_deepnorth_description: Túnica con ribetes dorados, digna solo de los magos más poderosos.
es.item_chest_mage_description: Esta túnica ingeniosamente hecha contiene hechizos y encantamiento tejidos en cada costura y pliegue.
es.item_chest_mage_gold_uncooked_descriptio: Esta armadura necesita endurecerse con escarcha.
es.item_chest_medium_ashlands_description: El primer hombre de Midgard supo proteger sus órganos más vitales, quizás con una coraza como esta.
es.item_chest_medium_deepnorth_description: Armadura de cuero elaborada con maestría, que ofrece gran protección sin limitar los movimientos.
es.item_chest_medium_gold_uncooked: Pieza fundida: peto de la Vanguardia
es.item_chest_medium_gold_uncooked_descript: Esta armadura necesita endurecerse con escarcha.
es.item_chest_pcuirass_description: Está forjado con elegancia y es tan resistente que puede desviar las espadas más afiladas.
es.item_chest_root_description: Blindaje ligero hecho de antiguas raíces y cortezas entrelazadas de forma extraña.
es.item_chest_trollleather_description: Despellejar a un trol no es tarea sencilla, pero su cuero es fuerte y cálido.
es.item_chest_tunic1_description: Una túnica sencilla de color azul.
es.item_chest_tunic2_description: Túnica azul complementada con una capa.
es.item_chest_tunic3_description: Túnica azul complementada con abalorios y plata.
es.item_chest_tunic4_description: Una túnica sencilla de color rojo.
es.item_chest_tunic5_description: Túnica roja complementada con una capa.
es.item_chest_tunic6_description: Túnica roja complementada con abalorios y bronce.
es.item_chest_tunic7_description: Una túnica sencilla de color amarillo.
es.item_chest_tunic8_description: Túnica amarilla complementada con una capa.
es.item_chest_tunic9_description: Túnica amarilla complementada con abalorios y plata.
es.item_chest_wolf_description: Jubón de piel de lobo que parece cálido y te da un toque salvaje. Protege del frío.
es.item_chicken_egg_description: Mantenlo tibio para ver que sale... pero antes que nada, ¿Qué vino primero?
es.item_chicken_meat_description: Todos los pollos llevan la maldición ancestral de ser deliciosos.
es.item_chitin_description: Una esquirla de una concha de crustáceo.
es.item_copper_description: Lingote de cobre listo para trabajarse.
es.item_copperore_description: Cobre sin refinar. Ha de refinarse en un horno de fundición.
es.item_copperscrap_description: La chatarra de una persona es el tesoro de otra.
es.item_crossbow_bloodlightning_gold_descri: La cuerda está tensa con poder contenido, como el aire antes de un rayo.
es.item_crossbow_bloodlightning_gold_uncook: Pieza fundida: ballesta de sangre de trueno

es.item_crossbow_frostfire_gold_description: Si tus enemigos no se congelan al apuntar, seguro que lo harán al ser alcanzados.
es.item_crossbow_frostfire_gold_uncooked: Pieza fundida: ballesta de fuego gélido
es.item_crossbow_frostfire_gold_uncooked_de: El mismo molde, pero con tendencia a dar un resultado más espectacular... La escarcha lo revelará todo, con el tiempo.
es.item_crossbow_gold_description: Esta arma encierra una fuerza increíble, a la espera de ser desatada.
es.item_crossbow_gold_uncooked_description: Hay que endurecer esta arma con escarcha.
es.item_crossbow_ripper_blood_description: Lista para hacer pedazos a tus enemigos.
es.item_crossbow_ripper_description: Desgarra a tus enemigos, así de simple.
es.item_crossbow_ripper_lightning_descripti: Las flechas atravesarán a tus enemigos como un vendaval especialmente desagradable.
es.item_crossbow_ripper_nature_description: Si la flecha no inmoviliza a tu enemigo, las raíces que surgen del suelo seguramente lo harán.
es.item_crownjewel_description: Un extraño poder recorre esta gema, diferente a cualquier cosa que hayas sentido antes.
es.item_cryptkey_description: Está cubierta de barro endurecido y huele a rancio.
es.item_crystal_description: Fragmento de cristal de las profundidades de la tierra.
es.item_cultivator_description: Una herramienta agraria para labrar la tierra.
es.item_cultivator_remove_description: Recoge las semillas de la tierra para volver a plantarlas en otra ocasión.
es.item_curedsquirrelhamstring: Tendón de jarrete de ardilla curado
es.item_curedsquirrelhamstring_description: Elástico y fuerte. Este tendón debe de proceder de un animal rápido y ágil.
es.item_damagemultiplierhp: Aumenta el daño a medida que disminuye la salud.
es.item_damagemultipliertotal: Aumenta el daño según la cantidad total de salud perdida.
es.item_demister_description: Un wisp vinculado que te guiará a través de las más frondosas neblinas.
es.item_dragonegg_description: Pesa bastante más de lo que parece y emite una especie de zumbido.
es.item_dragontear_description: Las últimas lágrimas congeladas de un dragón. Irradian una energía misteriosa.
es.item_dvergrkey_description: Un objeto usado para romper un sello Dvergr.
es.item_dvergrkeyfragment_description: Fragmento de un rompedor de sellos Dvergr.
es.item_Dyrnwyn_blade_description: Partes de una vieja hoja. Si se volvieran a ensamblar todas las piezas, probablemente podría recuperarse.
es.item_Dyrnwyn_hilt_description: La empuñadura de una espada olvidada hace mucho tiempo. Quizás podría reforjarse si estuvieran todas las piezas...
es.item_Dyrnwyn_tip_description: Este fragmento de metal parece la punta de una espada. Se podría reforjar la espada si se encontraran más piezas...
es.item_ectoplasm_description: La esencia inquieta de algo que una vez vivió...
es.item_eitr_description: Este es el material de la vida, el veneno que se consume a sí mismo. Los Dvergrs lo refinan para usarlo en sus máquinas esotéricas.
es.item_elakinghairbundle_description: El pelaje es denso, áspero y sorprendentemente limpio.
es.item_fader_drop_description: El poder místico se revelará algún día.
es.item_faderember_description: Cada brasa que vuela es un deseo ardiente de arrepentimiento.
es.item_feastashlands: Cuenco gourmet de las Tierras de Ceniza
es.item_feastashlands_description: Es difícil decir si el vapor que sale de este plato se debe a que está recién cocinado o a la carne de serpiente que contiene. Sea como fuere, la carne especiada junto con las parrabayas y los brotes de helecho es tan deliciosa que no importa.
es.item_feastblackforest: Bandeja de bufé del Bosque negro
es.item_feastblackforest_description: ¡No podrás resistirte a esta fuente de delicias de la Selva Negra! Los filetes de solomillo de venado se sirven junto con cardos y zanahorias especiados, y toda la comida se adereza con deliciosas mermeladas. ¡Venga, solo un mordisco más!
es.item_feastdeepnorth_description: Reconfortante y saciante, esta comida te dará energía incluso en los días más fríos. Las gachas y las tortitas combinan bien con mermeladas y salchichas, haciendo difícil no repetir.
es.item_feaster_description: Prepara la mesa con la comida y bebida que te apetezca e impresiona a tus invitados con un delicioso festín.
es.item_feaster_remove_description: <color=yellow>Una vez has comido algo del festín, no devolverá ningún recurso al eliminarse.
es.item_feastmeadows_description: Un jabalí asado a la perfección, glaseado con miel dulce y servido sobre una cama de champiñones y frambuesas, con costillas y colas de ciervo como acompañamiento. ¡Un festín como este seguro que te llenará la panza y te alegrará el día!
es.item_feastmistlands: Festín de setas al estilo de las Tierras Nubladas
es.item_feastmistlands_description: ¡Ha llegado el momento de que los amantes de las setas se alegren! Prueba diferentes tipos de setas, carne de serpiente marinada con setas y liebre neblinosa rellena de setas, y no te pierdas el sabroso aderezo de savia.
es.item_feastmountains: Guiso vigoroso del leñador de montaña
es.item_feastmountains_description: Reuníos en torno a esta olla humeante llena de delicias y entrad en calor después de un día de frío. La carne de lobo, normalmente dura y correosa, se ha vuelto tan tierna que prácticamente se derrite en la boca, y las cebollas y las zanahorias son aún más sabrosas con especias interesantes.
es.item_feastoceans_description: ¡Pescado, pescado y más pescado! ¡Y también carne de serpiente, cortada para que parezca pescado! Explora los sabores del océano, junto con algunas verduras de raíz a la parrilla para aquellos que aún están intentando acostumbrarse al mar.
es.item_feastplains: Pícnic de pastel de las llanuras
es.item_feastplains_description: ¡No hay nada banal en este banquete! Disfruta de pasteles y panes recién salidos del horno, tanto dulces como salados, y experimenta el equivalente culinario de un abrazo.
es.item_feastswamps_description: ¿Quién hubiera pensado que las sanguijuelas eran comestibles? Con la preparación adecuada (mucha cocción y muchos condimentos) podrás servirlas en este festín para los más valientes. Para los de estómago delicado, también hay sabrosas brochetas de salchichas y nabos como acompañamiento.
es.item_fierysvinstew_description: Este guiso mohoso es imprescindible en el menú de todo aventurero.
es.item_finewood_description: Madera de calidad para hacer obras de carpintería de primera.
es.item_fircone_big_description: Plántalo para que crezca un árbol de leño de construcción.
es.item_fircone_description: Plántala para que crezca un abeto.
es.item_fish_cooked_description: Una ración deliciosa de pescado ahumado.
es.item_fishandbread_description: Un tesoro tanto de tierra como de mar.
es.item_fishingbait_ashlands_description: A algunos peces les gusta cuando el agua está tibia, esta carnada lleva la temperatura hasta el punto de ebullición.
es.item_fishingbait_cave_description: Esta carnada no parece la gran cosa, pero es un deleite para un pez que vive donde sé es frío y oscuro.
es.item_fishingbait_deepnorth_description: No es muy nutritivo, por lo que los únicos peces que comerían esta carnada son los que están acostumbrados a comer hielo.
es.item_fishingbait_description: Cebo típico de los dvergr. La caña se vende por separado.
es.item_fishingbait_forest_description: Los trolls muertos en bosques atraen a uno o dos peces, ¡Acelera el proceso con esta carnada!
es.item_fishingbait_mistlands_description: Una carnada para guiar al pez hasta a ti a través de aguas envueltas.
es.item_fishingbait_ocean_description: Esta carnada llega hasta el fondo, lo suficiente como para atraer a peces que nadan en lo más profundo del océano.
es.item_fishingbait_plains_description: De la misma forma que no eres inmune a las picaduras de mosquitos, ¡Los peces de por aquí sí que no serán inmunes a esto!
es.item_fishingbait_swamp_description: Podrá tener un hedor nauseabundo, pero el pez que esta carnada atrae es usado para cosas mucho peores.
es.item_fishingrod_description: Caña de pescar normal y corriente de los dvergr.
es.item_fishwraps_description: Pan y pescado; no comerlo sería un pecado.
es.item_fistweapon_bjorn_undead_description: Estas garras desgarran carne y hueso por igual.
es.item_fistweapon_fenris_description: Si un lobo se vale de sus garras, así puede hacerlo un vikingo.
es.item_fistweapon_frostfire_gold_descripti: Un ligero riesgo de congelación es inevitable.
es.item_fistweapon_frostfire_gold_uncooked: Pieza fundida: nudillos de fuego gélido
es.item_fistweapon_frostfire_gold_uncooked_: El mismo molde, pero con tendencia a dar un resultado más espectacular... La escarcha lo revelará todo, con el tiempo.
